MGR_MOD_RELIC_MY_FRIEND.title: My Friend
MGR_MOD_RELIC_MY_FRIEND.description: At the start of combat, generate 1 Attack Note, 1 Skill Note, and 1 Power Note.
MGR_MOD_RELIC_MY_FRIEND.flavor: Ready to show the Spire your voice?
MGR_MOD_RELIC_JOURNEY_WITH_ME.title: Journey with Me
MGR_MOD_RELIC_JOURNEY_WITH_ME.descriptio:
At the start of each turn, generate 1 Attack Note, 1 Skill Note, and 1 Power Note.
On the first turn, also generate 1 Starry Note.
MGR_MOD_RELIC_JOURNEY_WITH_ME.flavor: Once the song begins, it never ends.
MGR_MOD_RELIC_MGR_FUMO.title: MGR Fumo
MGR_MOD_RELIC_MGR_FUMO.description: At the start of combat, gain 1 Forte.
MGR_MOD_RELIC_YOUR_STAGE.title: Your Stage
MGR_MOD_RELIC_YOUR_STAGE.description: The first Performance card you play each turn Performs 1 additional time.
MGR_MOD_RELIC_BOOK_OF_GRUDGES.title: Book of Grudges
MGR_MOD_RELIC_BOOK_OF_GRUDGES.descriptio: At the start of combat, generate 2 Attack Notes. For every 5 HP lost during the journey since obtaining this relic, generate 1 additional Attack Note.
MGR_MOD_RELIC_METRONOME.title: Metronome
MGR_MOD_RELIC_METRONOME.description: Every 7th Chord triggers twice. The count persists between combats.
MGR_MOD_RELIC_BLACK_GOLD_RECORD.title: Black Gold Record
MGR_MOD_RELIC_BLACK_GOLD_RECORD.descript: Whenever a Performance card finishes, gain {Gold:diff()} Gold.
MGR_MOD_RELIC_BLACK_GOLD_RECORD.flavor: Studio-pressed, limited edition, and personally signed by the singer.
MGR_MOD_RELIC_GUITAR_PICK.title: Guitar Pick
MGR_MOD_RELIC_GUITAR_PICK.description: Whenever a Chord triggers, gain 1 Block.
MGR_MOD_RELIC_GUITAR_PICK.flavor: Keep it safe. These are very easy to lose TT
MGR_MOD_RELIC_PALE_FLOWER.title: Pale Flower
MGR_MOD_RELIC_PALE_FLOWER.description: At the start of combat, add 1 [color=#c8c8c8]Pale+[/color] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
MGR_MOD_RELIC_PALE_FLOWER.flavor: In a Spire without sunlight, even flowers turn pale.
MGR_MOD_RELIC_MAGUROYAKI.title: Maguroyaki
MGR_MOD_RELIC_MAGUROYAKI.description: Whenever you Smith at a Rest Site, heal {Heal:diff()}% of your Max HP.
MGR_MOD_RELIC_MAGUROYAKI.flavor: Is the filling sweet bean paste, or tuna?
MGR_MOD_RELIC_LITTLE_ANGEL.title: Little Angel
MGR_MOD_RELIC_LITTLE_ANGEL.description: At the start of your turn, if your initial draw contained fewer than {SkillThreshold:diff()} Skills, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
MGR_MOD_RELIC_LITTLE_ANGEL.flavor: May it help you escape misfortune.
